description:
SuperRoad - Dominate the Road: The Motobecane Turino Comp XTL disc brake road bike is built for riders who want an aluminum road bike with a carbon fork, Shimano STI shifting, disc brakes and extra XTL brake lever control.

Powerful disc brakes, a custom aero rim wheelset, lightweight aluminum frame and precision carbon bladed fork make this a strong value for road, commute and fitness riding. The frame is capable of using tires as wide as 700x45c, with fork clearance around 40c. Fitment of non-stock tires is not guaranteed due to tire manufacturer variations.

The XTL / cross-top brake levers add extra braking control near the stem, making it easier to brake from the bar tops in traffic, stops and other situations where quick hand access matters.

Key features: Shimano STI 21 speed drivetrain, triple crankset, Tektro mechanical disc brakes with 160mm rotors, Weinmann XP2000 aero wheels, carbon fork and lightweight aluminum frame.

components.description: BB-7420ST cartridge sealed bottom bracket, JIS square, chromoly spindle, 68mm shell x 113mm.
Tektro road mechanical disc brakes with flat disc mount and TR160-22 160mm rotors. Includes XTL / cross-top brake lever technology plus Shimano ST-A073 shift/brake levers.
Shimano HG 7-speed cassette, 28T, with KMC Z51 narrow chain, 1/2 x 3/32 in. x 110L. Shimano 3x7 drivetrain, 21 speeds.
Shimano FC-A073 triple crankset for rear 7/8-speed, 170mm, 50/39/30T with lightweight aluminum arms
700C carbon fork with alloy 1-1/8 in. steerer, carbon straight blade, flat disc mount, eyelet, 45mm offset, cable guide and maximum stated tire 700x40C.

Road bar, 31.8mm clamp, alloy with built-in tunnel, 400/420/440mm by size group. 6061 alloy Tioga-OS stem, -6 degree, 90/100/110mm by size group. FSA No.8D/DJ 1-1/8 in. integrated headset with 45/45 ACB. Black gel synthetic cork tape
Road bike pedals with 9/16 in. boron axle included Bikes come up to 90 percent assembled
Road racing saddle with comfort channel. 6061 alloy seatpost, 27.2mm x 300mm.
Shimano ST-A073 STI shift/brake levers with optical gear display, Shimano FD-A073 band-type front derailleur with 31.8mm adapter
Kenda K176 700x28C 22 TPI tires. Frame fits up to most 40C tires.

Weinmann XP2000 alloy 700C pinned-type black anodized 32H rims, 700C 32H alloy disc front hub with 100mm spacing and Shimano Compatible rear hub with 135mm spacing, alloy quick releases, 14G black stainless spokes with 14mm brass nipples
